main_text.p: etiam clangebant fono fixo & æquabili, quod Verbo הקע significatur. Pyhal רעע Vociferatio agitata fuit. Hithpahel התרעע. Vide aliter in רעע & רעה.
ריק Hiphil הריק Evacuare, Effundere: Proferre, Evaginare, cum de gladio dicitur. Hophal הוּרַק Diffundi Transfundi.
ריק m. Vacuus, Inanis: Vanus: plurale ריקים. Fœmin. ריקה Vacua: plur. ריקות.
ריק m. Inanitas, Inane: Inaniter, Frustra.
ריקם Inanit r, Immeritò: Vacuè, Vacuus.
רכב : quitare, Equo insidere, Vehi curru vel equo: Hiphil הרכיב, Vehere vel Vehi fecit, Vexit, Vehendum impofuit.
רכב m. Currus: item Catillus, mola superior, quæ Vehitur super inferiorem, quæ Meta dicitur: plur. רכבים Currus.
מרכב m. Sedile, ephippium, Stratum, Stragula equi, Equitatus: f. מרכבה & מרכבת Currus: plur. מרכבות.

page.notes: Hebrew and Greek-free Latin rendered as printed; the Hebrew vowel points are much faded on the scan and are given only as consonantal forms where unclear; the second Hebrew entry word on line 2 and the Hebrew forms in entries 5, 9 and 13 are reconstructed from the consonants and should be checked against the scan. Catchword is the Hebrew word at the lower right.
